requiredBusinessCapabilities.name: Create Dimension / Account
requiredBusinessCapabilities.description: System must create new cost center dimensions and GL accounts with unique references.

requiredBusinessCapabilities.name: Edit Account / Dimension Name
requiredBusinessCapabilities.description: System must allow editing the dimension name while preserving historical transaction history.

requiredBusinessCapabilities.name: Edit Account / Dimension Code
requiredBusinessCapabilities.description: System must allow editing business reference codes after validating no duplicate exists.

requiredBusinessCapabilities.name: Archive Dimension / Account
requiredBusinessCapabilities.description: Soft archive (closed = 1) cost center dimensions while maintaining audit trail.

requiredBusinessCapabilities.name: Audit Trail Structural Changes
requiredBusinessCapabilities.description: Log all structural dimension and GL account code/name modifications in 0_audit_trail.
